verses.cheikh-ahmed-tidiane-sy-tahat-binuri-jam: tāhat binūri jamālika l-ʾaḥlamu yā man huwa l-khalaqu wal-ʿalamu
waʾabā siwāka l-ḥaqqu min dhī ḥaqqihim waʾatat tuʾayyidu mulkaka l-ʾayyāmu
falʾanta rabbu wāḥidu biṣifātihi wafiʿālihi bishahādati tuʿtāmu
walʾanta khayru mukawwini wamuqaddiri wamuhaymini tajrī lahu l-ʾaḥkāmu
mā kullu shayʾi fī l-ʿawālimi kullihā ʾila kamā khaṭṭat bihi l-ʾaqlamu
fash-shamsu wal-qamaru l-munīru waghayruhu wal-ʾarḍu wal-mirrīkhu wal-ʾajrāmu
taʾatī liʿayni murāqibi min naẓrati fakamā qtaḍāhu riʿāyatu waniẓāmu
lakinna dhātaka la turā ʾila kamā tandakku qurba jalalihā l-ʾaʿlamu
mā n-nāsu mā l-ʾakwānu mā l-malʾu lladhī fī l-jawwi mā l-ʾaflaku mā l-ʾarqāmu
ʾila ghubāru ṭāra min quṭri s-samā wamina s-samāʾi mina l-ʾumūri ʿiẓāmu
ʾaḥkamta sayra l-khalqi lil-hadafi lladhī ʿajazat bidarki ṭawiyyihi l-ḥukkāmu
faghadat qulūbu l-ʿāshiqīna jamīʿuhā gharaḍā taduqqu kaʾannahā ʾanghāmu
fal-ʿilmu wal-qānūnu wal-ʿaqlu dh-dhakī war-raʾayū wat-tadbīru wal-ʾiʿlamu
kullu yaqūmu bidawrihi fī ẓillihi wafqa l-mashīʾati mā ʾutīḥa qiyāmu
hadhā biʾamri minka dūna mushāriki ʾabadā waʾamru minka fīhi salamu
hadhā waʾahlu l-ʾarḍi taṭlubu rizqahā māʾa wanabtā ḥawlahu ʾanʿāmu
wakhaṣāʾiṣa l-ghāzāti waṭ-ṭāqāti fī salbi waʾījābi lahu ʾilhāmu
mā l-ʾarḍu ʾila kutlahu fī ḍimnihā shayʾu mina l-ʾāyāti fīhi wiʾāmu
wahunāka milyāru mina l-kutulati la tarḍā bighayri riḍāka ḥīna tusāmu
fī ʿaẓmihā waḥadīdihā waramādihā fī rūḥihā wajamīʿuhā ʾaqsāmu
ʾinna l-ḥayāta bikullihā hiyā laḥẓaḍu yantābuhā l-ʾiqdāmu wal-ʾiḥjāmu
waʾamāma ʾāyāti ṭ-ṭabīʿati qad ghadā tatakhabbaṭu l-kuttābu war-ruwwāmu
mā fīhimu lin-nāsi ʾila ḥāʾiru wamuḥayyaru taṭghā bihi l-ʾafhāmu
law la n-nubuwwatu minka wal-waḥyū lladhī salakat binahji sabīlihi l-ʾaqwāmu
waʾatā bihi mūsā biʾalwāḥi samat waghadā biʾisrāʾīla fīhi lizāmu
warawā bihi ʿīsā l-masīḥu waḥawlahu zumaru biʾawsāṭi r-rijāli kirāmu
wahadā bihi ʾahla l-bisāṭi muḥammadu litazūla ʿan ghāyātihi l-ʾawhāmu
fāsʾal ʾujibka biʾanna nūra l-muṣṭafā ṭahurat bihi l-ʾarwāḥu wal-ʾajsāmu
faḥaḍāratu mā baʿdahā min madhhabi wakifāyatu fī nafsihā waqiwāmu
wahidāyatu ʿammat bighayri tafalsufi waʾamānatu ʾaddā bihā l-ʾislamu
la raʾayā baʿda ḥaqīqati fī ṭayyihā sirru l-ḥayāti wafīhi baʿdu marāmu
walaka l-khiyāru famuʾuminu fī ḥiṣnihi ʾaw munkiru talhū bihi l-ʾaṣnāmu
wahunāka ʾaṭyabu mā yakūnu ḥalaluhu ʿaqla waʾakhbathu mā yakūnu ḥarāmu
wal-ḥādithātu wamā bihā min ḥikmahi watanāwubu l-ʾaʿwāmi fal-ʾaʿwāmu
fataṣarrufātu min ʾilahi qādiri ʾidh la yafī bil-ḥādithāti kalamu
fājʿal mina l-ʾashyāʾi ḥaẓẓaka khibrata btafakkuri yadnū bihi l-ʾilmāmu
mā muntahā suqrāṭa wal-malʾi l-ʾulā tabiʿūhu ʾila ghurbahu faḥimāmu
wakadhāka ʾaflaṭūnu fī ʾārāʾihi mā n-naqdu ḥarrarahu wala l-ʾibrāmu
man lam yaʿʿuda muḥammadā fī ʿilmihi fal-ʿilmu fīhi khasāratu wamalamu
ṣallā ʿalayhi llāhu kulla daqīqati waʿalā l-ʾulā ṣallā ʿalayhi waqāmū
yā ʾaḥkama th-thaqalayni fī ʾirshādihi yā man likulli l-muhtadīna ʾimāmu
yā ʾaḥmadu l-mabʿūthu bil-ḥaqqi lladhī khaḍaʿa r-riqābu ʾilayhi wal-ʾaqdāmu
hadhā birūḥi minka la bidiʿāyati ʾinna d-diʿāyata bidʿahu waẓalamu
mā mithluka l-ʾumarāʾu ʾanta ʾamīruhum fī l-ḥukmi ʾaw fī sh-shuhrati l-ʾahrāmu
wamina s-samādi banā ʿazīza ḥayātihim wamina s-sanāʾi banayta yā qamqāmu
qaṣru yuhhadadu bil-kharābi likullihim yawmā waqaṣru bil-ʾamāni yuqāmu
kibru yukannafu bil-qadhāʾifi ʿindahum wahudā hudāhu ʿibādatu waṣiyāmu
wad-dīnu baynaka fī l-bqāʿi wabaynahum wal-qabru wal-malakāni la l-ʾazlamu
